_comment: A10 golden fixture: two request_logs rows (model A and model B) that were called on the SAME prompt.

The message lists below are structurally identical (same role, same text, same image placeholder, same tool-call arguments) -- they differ only in the resolved model id / provider strings, which must NOT be part of the prompt canonical hash.

A diff of the two log rows joined on prompt_hash must show: identical prompt_hash, different model_alias / model_id, comparable tokens and latency. This is the acceptance-criterion #5 comparison surface.
The 'model_alias' / 'model_id' / 'provider' fields are request_logs row fields, NOT part of the hash input. The hash is computed from (role, system, messages) only.
